feeds.title: Shelter Designs Yurt Blog
feeds.description: Shelter Designs is a custom yurt manufacturer based in Missoula, Montana, and a simple and elegant solution for many seasons. Whether you're an experienced yurt conisseur or just getting started, the Shelter Designs blog has the latest stories you need to start your yurt journey.

feeds.title: Secret Creek Blog
feeds.description: Secret Creek is the maker of Colorado Yurts, Earthworks Tipis, and Destination Tents. We have hand-crafted the best quality yurts, tipis and tents for customers around the world. Read our company updates and success stories, get ideas, and tips, discover you and much more.

feeds.title: Yurt Specialists Blog
feeds.description: Yurt Specialists is a family company with experience in making beautifully handcrafted yurts. Our designs are inspired by East Asians, with some minor adjustments. See where all our Yurts have reached in our blog, our new design ideas, and much more.

feeds.title: Sky Ridge Yurts Blog
feeds.description: At Sky Ridge, We offer a place with nature without giving up the comforts of home. You'll find seven well-appointed yurts perched high atop a mountainous ridge. Read about Yurtlife experiences and how to become a Yurt resort owner. Some of our media features will be posted on our blog as well.

feeds.title: Blackdown Yurts Blog
feeds.description: In Devon's Hidden Valley, discover the abundance of nature and wildlife in beautiful surroundings with a unique glamping adventure for the whole family at Blackdown Yurts. Our Blog has seasonal, environmental and local news in and around the Devon yurts.

feeds.title: Devon Yurts Blog
feeds.description: Hemsford Yurt Camp is located in the tranquil Hems Valley. Enjoy a unique and memorable glamping holiday with a difference in an authentic Yurt. Read Devon Yurts, Glamping in Style - Liz Jeffery talks about the different seasons you can stay at the Yurt and what you should expect.

feeds.title: Yurt Spaces Blog
feeds.description: USA's leading Yurt Company Yurtspaces is the perfect destination for Authentic, Luxurious, and Custom-designed Yurts. We offer many authentic Mongolian yurt patterns that are produced there too. We custom design our yurts according to our client's requirements. Our blog is a journal for all the Yurt enthusiasts.

feeds.title: Original Mongolian Yurts Blog
feeds.description: Original Yurts are the maker and seller of authentic Mongolian Yurts, located in Mongolia. We are the only company making yurts in our own workshop in Mongolia and selling worldwide directly. We write about our Yurts which are used worldwide and more.

feeds.title: Pacific Yurts Blog
feeds.description: Pacific Yurts sets the highest standard for quality, service and proven performance. Portable building manufacturer in Oregon. If you love yurts, stay informed on yurt tips, design inspirations, yurt glamping guides, product announcements, customer stories & more!

feeds.title: Tiny House Blog » Yurts
feeds.description: Enjoy experiences about living Off the Grid with Yurt homes and tiny guesthouses in the Tiny House Blog. Blog Author Ken Griswold writes and documents the advances of the modern-day tiny house movement. The goal of the tiny house blog is to discover the different options available for a person looking to downsize into a tiny house or cabin.

feeds.title: Hidden Valley Yurts Blog
feeds.description: Hidden Valley Yurts and The Lake House have five traditional Mongolian yurts and a lakeside holiday home. With our guests in mind, we wanted each property to have the 'Home Away From Home' vibe. Check out the latest news and blog updates from Hidden Valley Yurts and Lake House, at Lower Glyn Farm in the Wye Valley.

feeds.title: Strawberry Skys Yurts Blog
feeds.description: Glamping in the beautiful rolling hills of mid-Wales. A wonderfully secluded site with plenty of space to relax and enjoy your surroundings. Each yurt is fully furnished and heated by a wood burner. Keep up with recent activities and developments at Strawberry Skys Yurts with musings on related (or sometimes not) subjects.

feeds.title: Freedom Yurt Cabins Blog
feeds.description: Freedom Yurt Cabins manufactures affordable off-grid structures that use high-quality materials, quality craftsmanship, and a legendary product. Read all about living in a Yurt Cabin - Benefits, Useful Lifehacks, and some great Design tips here in our blog.

feeds.title: Yurt In The Dirt Blog
feeds.description: At Yurt in the Dirt, we provide a range of alternative living solutions. We sell Yurts and Geo Domes from a quality manufacturer in China and sell in Denmark and Western Australia. Get inspired about alternative living, whether it's Yurts, Geo Domes or Tiny Houses, you'll find our stories here.

feeds.title: Campden Yurts Blog
feeds.description: Campden Yurts is a small glamping site open from April - October, offering yurt holidays in the North Cotswolds. We try to be as sustainable as possible, consequently 'to do very little harm'. FAQs - glamping, safety, things to do in the Cotswolds, with children, with dogs, best places to eat/visit.
